title: Show the baked room
author: claude
summary: The room file loads, and most surfaces simply show their baked light.
what: The room component loads the baked room file. Most surfaces just show their light map. The glossy parts are real shiny materials that show only box-projected reflections.
why: Baked surfaces are cheap to draw. Only the glossy parts need to react to reflections.
how:
- Glossy parts: black metal, the credenza's brass, marble and walnut, the oak floor and the window frame.
- The chandelier hides when you look straight down (within 40 degrees).

tech.name: three.js
tech.plain: Draws 3D scenes in the web browser.

tech.name: React Three Fiber
tech.plain: Lets us describe a three.js scene with React building blocks.

tech.name: Light maps
tech.plain: Pictures of how bright each surface is, laid over the walls and floor so the browser does not have to calculate light.

tech.name: Box projection
tech.plain: A trick that makes reflections line up with the real walls instead of looking infinitely far away.

meta.basicMaterials: most materials become MeshBasicMaterial with the light map
